name: TCPL Packaging Limited
summary: TCPL Packaging Limited manufactures and sells paperboard-based packaging, flexible packaging, rigid boxes, and gravure printing cylinders in India. The company offers folding cartons, printed blanks and outers, litho-laminated cartons, shaped cartons, metallized paperboard cartons, coated food packaging, and secure document envelope cartons; flexible packaging products, such as printed laminates, pouches, wrap-around labels, and shrink sleeves; MDO Polyethylene (PE) / PE structures, PE-based barrier formats, paper cups with compostable coatings, paper / compostable PE structures, recyclable films and other selected mono-material or recyclable packaging solutions; and rigid boxes and premium …
